minimp3 - https://github.com/lieff/minimp3  (CC0 1.0, public domain; see LICENSE)
Unmodified copies of minimp3.h and minimp3_ex.h, downloaded 2026-10-13.

Used only through io/mp3_reader/mp3_reader.c, which defines
MINIMP3_IMPLEMENTATION, MINIMP3_NO_STDIO and MINIMP3_NO_SIMD (portable C, no
SSE, so it also runs on a Pentium-class Windows 98 machine).
To update: replace the two headers; nothing else in the project includes them.
